notes: The title block has two lines: Project Title with Date Prepared, then Team Member with Role. The activity boxes print numbered lines: 1 to 6 for Activities Planned for This Reporting Period, 1 to 6 for Activities Accomplished This Reporting Period, 1 to 4 for Activities Planned but Not Accomplished This Reporting Period, 1 to 5 for Activities Planned for Next Reporting Period. New Risks Identified and New Issues Identified are headings over a bordered box whose top cell is labelled Risk (or Issue) with one blank cell below it. Disagreements with the prose table (Table 4.1), where the blank form wins: the prose says Activities planned this reporting period where the form prints Activities Planned for This Reporting Period; the prose lists Root cause of variances twice where the form prints Root Cause of Activity Variances and Root Cause of Cost Variances; the prose misprints Planned corrective of preventive action; the prose says Issues where the form prints New Issues Identified; the prose has no Team Member or Role element.
